answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 20287 Country: United Kingdom Title: when husband and wife sleep together should they have a bath straight away or is it ok to have a bath in the morning before fajir? Question: when husband and wife sleep together should they have a bath straight away or is it ok to have a bath in the morning before fajir? Answer ID: 20287 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 476/376/H=1431) Ghusl is not wajib only by sleeping together. However, if you had intercourse or wet dream then taking a bath is wajib. It is better to have bath as soon as possible, however it is also allowable if one takes bath before Fajr salah so that he might not miss the salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
